items.translation: Instrumentation 默认使用 org.springframework.http.client.observation.ClientRequestObservationConvention，其由 ClientRequestObservationContext 提供支持。

items.translation: HTTP 响应原始状态码，或者如果没有创建响应则为"UNKNOWN"。

items.source: Outcome of the HTTP server exchange.
items.translation: HTTP 服务器交换的结果。

items.source: It uses the org.springframework.scheduling.support.DefaultScheduledTaskObservationConvention by default, backed by the ScheduledTaskObservationContext. You can configure a custom implementation on the ObservationRegistry directly. During the execution of the scheduled method, the current observation is restored in the ThreadLocal context or the Reactor context (if the scheduled method returns a Mono or Flux type).
items.translation: 默认情况下，它使用 org.springframework.scheduling.support.DefaultScheduledTaskObservationConvention，该约定由 ScheduledTaskObservationContext 支持。您可以直接在 ObservationRegistry 上配置自定义实现。在执行计划方法期间，当前观察会在 ThreadLocal 上下文中恢复，或者在 Reactor 上下文中恢复（如果计划方法返回 Mono 或 Flux 类型）。

items.source: If the application globally configures a custom ApplicationEventMulticaster with a strategy that schedules event processing on different threads, this is no longer true. All @EventListener methods will be processed on a different thread, outside the main event publication thread. In these cases, the Micrometer Context Propagation library can help propagate such values and better correlate the processing of the events. The application can configure the chosen TaskExecutor to use a ContextPropagatingTaskDecorator that decorates tasks and propagates context. For this to work, the io.micrometer:context-propagation library must be present on the classpath:
items.translation: 如果应用程序全局配置了一个自定义的ApplicationEventMulticaster，其策略是在不同线程上调度事件处理，那么这种情况就不再适用。 所有@EventListener方法将在主事件发布线程之外的不同线程上进行处理。 在这些情况下，Micrometer 上下文传播库可以帮助传播这些值，并更好地关联事件的處理。 应用程序可以配置所选的TaskExecutor以使用ContextPropagatingTaskDecorator来装饰任务并传播上下文。 要使此功能生效，类路径上必须存在io.micrometer:context-propagation库：

items.source: Each Observation holds KeyValues metadata. In the case of an HTTP server observation, this could be the HTTP request method, the HTTP response status, and so forth. This metadata is contributed by ObservationConvention implementations which should declare the type of ObservationContext they support.

items.source: Spring Framework uses the Jakarta JMS instrumentation provided by Micrometer if the io.micrometer:micrometer-jakarta9 dependency is on the classpath. The io.micrometer.jakarta9.instrument.jms.JmsInstrumentation instruments jakarta.jms.Session and records the relevant observations.
items.translation: Spring Framework 会在类路径中存在 io.micrometer:micrometer-jakarta9 依赖时，使用 Micrometer 提供的 Jakarta JMS 仪器。 io.micrometer.jakarta9.instrument.jms.JmsInstrumentation 会对 jakarta.jms.Session 进行仪器并记录相关的观测数据。

items.source: "jms.message.process" when a JMS message is processed by the application, typically with a MessageListener or a @JmsListener annotated method.
items.translation: "jms.message.process" 当应用程序处理 JMS 消息时，通常使用 MessageListener 或带有 @JmsListener 注解的方法。

items.source: Applications must configure an ObservationRegistry on RestTemplate instances to enable the instrumentation; without that, observations are "no-ops". Spring Boot will auto-configure RestTemplateBuilder beans with the observation registry already set.
items.translation: 应用程序必须在RestTemplate实例上配置一个ObservationRegistry以启用仪器；否则，观察将变为“空操作”。Spring Boot 会自动配置带有已设置的观察注册表的RestTemplateBuilderbean。

items.source: Applications must configure an ObservationRegistry on the WebClient.Builder to enable the instrumentation; without that, observations are "no-ops". Spring Boot will auto-configure WebClient.Builder beans with the observation registry already set.
items.translation: 应用程序必须在WebClient.Builder上配置一个ObservationRegistry以启用 instrumentation；否则，observations 将是“no-ops”。Spring Boot 将自动配置带有已设置的 observation registry 的WebClient.Builder bean。

items.source: Spring Framework instruments various parts of its own codebase to publish observations if an ObservationRegistry is configured. You can learn more about configuring the observability infrastructure in Spring Boot.
items.translation: Spring Framework 对其代码库的多个部分进行了增强，以便在配置了ObservationRegistry时发布观测数据。您可以进一步了解如何在Spring Boot 中配置可观测性基础设施。

items.source: Observation is the actual recording of something happening in your application. This is processed by ObservationHandler implementations to produce metrics or traces.
items.translation: Observation 是您应用程序中实际发生的某件事的记录。它由 ObservationHandler 实现进行处理，以生成指标或跟踪数据。

items.source: KeyValues are said to be "low cardinality" if there is a low, bounded number of possible values for the KeyValue tuple (HTTP method is a good example). Low cardinality values are contributed to metrics only. Conversely, "high cardinality" values are unbounded (for example, HTTP request URIs) and are only contributed to traces.
items.translation: KeyValues 如果其 KeyValue 元组的可能值数量较低且有界，则被称为“低基数”（HTTP 方法就是一个很好的例子）。低基数值仅贡献给指标。相反，“高基数”值是无限的（例如 HTTP 请求 URI），且仅贡献给追踪。

items.source: providing a custom ObservationConvention to change the default observation name and extracted KeyValues
items.translation: 通过提供自定义的ObservationConvention来更改默认的观测名称和提取的KeyValues。

items.source: You can configure ObservationFilter instances on the ObservationRegistry.
items.translation: 您可以在ObservationRegistry上配置ObservationFilter实例。

items.translation: "jms.message.publish" 在将 JMS 消息发送到代理时，通常使用 JmsTemplate。

items.source: Name of the JMS operation being performed (values: "publish" or "process").
items.translation: 正在执行的 JMS 操作名称（值："publish" 或 "process"）。

items.translation: 您需要配置JmsTemplate上的ObservationRegistry以启用观察：

items.translation: 它默认使用io.micrometer.jakarta9.instrument.jms.DefaultJmsPublishObservationConvention，由io.micrometer.jakarta9.instrument.jms.JmsPublishObservationContext提供支持。

items.source: A default container factory is required to enable the annotation support, but note that @JmsListener annotations can refer to specific container factory beans for specific purposes. In all cases, Observations are only recorded if the observation registry is configured on the container factory.

items.translation: 此观察默认使用io.micrometer.jakarta9.instrument.jms.DefaultJmsProcessObservationConvention，并由io.micrometer.jakarta9.instrument.jms.JmsProcessObservationContext提供支持。

items.source: HTTP server exchange observations are created with the name "http.server.requests" for Servlet and Reactive applications, or "http.server.request.duration" if using the OpenTelemetry convention.
items.translation: HTTP 服务器交换观察结果对于 Servlet 和响应式应用程序使用名称"http.server.requests"创建，或者如果使用 OpenTelemetry 约定则使用"http.server.request.duration"。

items.source: It uses the org.springframework.http.server.observation.DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention by default, backed by the ServerRequestObservationContext.
items.translation: 它默认使用org.springframework.http.server.observation.DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention，由ServerRequestObservationContext提供支持。

items.source: An OpenTelemetry variant is available with org.springframework.http.server.observation.OpenTelemetryServerRequestObservationConvention, backed by the ServerRequestObservationContext.
items.translation: 有一个使用 org.springframework.http.server.observation.OpenTelemetryServerRequestObservationConvention 的 OpenTelemetry 变体，它由 ServerRequestObservationContext 提供支持。

items.source: This variant complies with the OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions for HTTP Metrics (v1.36.0) and the OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions for HTTP Spans (v1.36.0).
items.translation: 此变体符合OpenTelemetry HTTP 指标语义约定 (v1.36.0)和OpenTelemetry HTTP 跨度语义约定 (v1.36.0)。

items.source: It uses the org.springframework.http.server.reactive.observation.DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention by default, backed by the ServerRequestObservationContext.
items.translation: 它默认使用org.springframework.http.server.reactive.observation.DefaultServerRequestObservationConvention，由ServerRequestObservationContext提供支持。

items.source: HTTP client exchange observations are created with the name "http.client.requests" for blocking and reactive clients. This observation measures the entire HTTP request/response exchange, from connection establishment up to body deserialization. Unlike their server counterparts, the instrumentation is implemented directly in the client so the only required step is to configure an ObservationRegistry on the client.
items.translation: HTTP 客户端的交换观察对象以名称 "http.client.requests" 创建，适用于阻塞式和响应式客户端。此观察对象测量整个 HTTP 请求/响应交换过程，从连接建立到主体反序列化。与服务器端对应项不同，该工具实现直接位于客户端中，因此唯一需要的步骤是在客户端上配置一个 ObservationRegistry。

items.source: Applications must configure an ObservationRegistry on the RestClient.Builder to enable the instrumentation; without that, observations are "no-ops".
items.translation: 应用程序必须在RestClient.Builder上配置一个ObservationRegistry以启用仪器；否则，观察将变为“空操作”。

items.source: Instrumentation uses the org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.ClientRequestObservationConvention by default, backed by the ClientRequestObservationContext.
items.translation: Instrumentation 默认使用 org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.ClientRequestObservationConvention，其由 ClientRequestObservationContext 提供支持。

items.source: Spring Framework does not contribute Observations for @EventListener calls, as they don’t have the right semantics for such instrumentation. By default, event publication and processing are done synchronously and on the same thread. This means that during the execution of that task, the ThreadLocals and logging context will be the same as the event publisher.
items.translation: Spring Framework 不为 @EventListener 调用 贡献 Observations，因为它们不具备此类仪器所需的正确语义。默认情况下，事件发布和处理是同步并在同一线程上进行的。这意味着在该任务执行期间，ThreadLocals 和日志上下文将与事件发布者相同。

items.source: Micrometer defines an Observation concept that enables both Metrics and Traces in applications. Metrics support offers a way to create timers, gauges, or counters for collecting statistics about the runtime behavior of your application. Metrics can help you to track error rates, usage patterns, performance, and more. Traces provide a holistic view of an entire system, crossing application boundaries; you can zoom in on particular user requests and follow their entire completion across applications.
items.translation: Micrometer 定义了一个Observation 概念，可在应用程序中同时支持 Metrics 和 Traces。 Metrics 支持提供了一种创建计时器、仪表或计数器的方法，用于收集有关应用程序运行时行为的统计信息。 Metrics 可帮助您跟踪错误率、使用模式、性能等。 Traces 提供对整个系统的全面视图，跨越应用程序边界；您可以放大查看特定的用户请求，并追踪其跨应用程序的整个完成过程。

items.source: Spring Framework instruments various features for observability. As outlined at the beginning of this section, observations can generate timer Metrics and/or Traces depending on the configuration.
items.translation: Spring Framework 为可观测性对多种功能进行了增强。正如本节开头所述，观察结果会根据配置生成计时器指标和/或追踪信息。

items.source: Each observation has a corresponding ObservationContext implementation; this type holds all the relevant information for extracting metadata for it. In the case of an HTTP server observation, the context implementation could hold the HTTP request, the HTTP response, any exception thrown during processing, and so forth.
items.translation: 每个观察项都有一个对应的 ObservationContext 实现；该类型包含提取其元数据所需的所有相关信息。对于 HTTP 服务器观察项，上下文实现可能包含 HTTP 请求、HTTP 响应、处理过程中抛出的任何异常等等。

items.source: An ObservationDocumentation documents all observations in a particular domain, listing the expected key names and their meaning.
items.translation: ObservationDocumentation 记录特定领域中的所有观测值，列出预期的键名及其含义。

items.source: You can also achieve similar goals using a custom ObservationFilter – adding or removing key values for an observation. Filters do not replace the default convention and are used as a post-processing component.
items.translation: 您也可以使用自定义的ObservationFilter来实现类似的目标——为观测值添加或移除键值。过滤器不会替代默认约定，而是作为后处理组件使用。

items.source: Class name of the exception thrown during the execution, or "none" if no exception happened.

items.source: "jms.message.publish" observations are recorded when a JMS message is sent to the broker. They measure the time spent sending the message and propagate the tracing information with outgoing JMS message headers.
items.translation: "jms.message.publish" 观察记录在将 JMS 消息发送到代理时生成。它们测量发送消息所花费的时间，并通过传出 JMS 消息标头传播跟踪信息。

items.source: Similar observations are recorded with @JmsListener annotated methods when response messages are returned from the listener method.
items.translation: 类似观察结果也记录在从监听器方法返回响应消息的带有@JmsListener注解的方法中。

items.source: "jms.message.process" observations are recorded when a JMS message is processed by the application. They measure the time spent processing the message and propagate the tracing context with incoming JMS message headers.
items.translation: "jms.message.process" 观察项在应用程序处理 JMS 消息时进行记录。它们测量处理消息所花费的时间，并随传入的 JMS 消息标头传播跟踪上下文。

items.translation: 应用程序需要在应用中配置 org.springframework.web.filter.ServerHttpObservationFilter Servlet 过滤器。

items.source: Currently there is no instrumentation for "jms.message.receive" observations as there is little value in measuring the time spent waiting for the receipt of a message. Such an integration would typically instrument MessageConsumer#receive method calls. But once those return, the processing time is not measured and the trace scope cannot be propagated to the application.
items.translation: 目前尚无针对 "jms.message.receive" 观测的监控，因为测量等待接收消息所花费的时间价值不大。 此类集成通常会监控 MessageConsumer#receive 方法调用。但一旦这些调用返回，处理时间便未被测量，且跟踪范围无法传播到应用程序中。

items.source: Observations use Micrometer’s official naming convention, but Metrics names will be automatically converted to the format preferred by the monitoring system backend (Prometheus, Atlas, Graphite, InfluxDB…​).
items.translation: Observations 使用 Micrometer 的官方命名约定，但 Metrics 名称将自动转换 为监控系统后端（Prometheus、Atlas、Graphite、InfluxDB…​）首选的格式。

items.source: Because the instrumentation is done at the Servlet Filter level, the observation scope only covers the filters ordered after this one as well as the handling of the request. Typically, Servlet container error handling is performed at a lower level and won’t have any active observation or span. For this use case, a container-specific implementation is required, such as a org.apache.catalina.Valve for Tomcat; this is outside the scope of this project.
items.translation: 由于 instrumentation 是在 Servlet Filter 级别完成的，因此观察范围仅涵盖此过滤器之后的所有过滤器以及请求的处理。 通常，Servlet 容器的错误处理在较低级别执行，不会有任何活跃的 observation 或 span。 对于这种用例，需要容器特定的实现，例如 Tomcat 中的 org.apache.catalina.Valve；这超出了本项目的范围。
